newsitem.title: GREECE: EXELIXI FUND DECLARES 70 DRS INTERIM DIV/SHARE.
newsitem.headline: EXELIXI FUND DECLARES 70 DRS INTERIM DIV/SHARE.

text.p: Greek closed-end fund Exelixi got shareholder approval for the distribution of an interim dividend per share of 70 drachmas, it said in a statement.
"The annual general meeting decided to pay an interim dividend of 70 drachmas per share on the back of excellent financial results for the first five months of 1997," it said.
Its shares will trade ex-dividend on July 28.
Shareholders were told capital gains and portfolio income for the January-May 1997 period reached 450 million drachmas, yielding profits of 400 million.
As of the end of May 1997, its portfolio had unrealised capital gains of 286 million drachmas.
The assembly also approved the set up of a small financial services company (EPEY) with a share capital of 30 million drachmas.
Currently, Exelixi has invested 65 percent of its portfolio in shares listed on the Athens bourse. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
